name: Non AI Agent Migration to Chat 2.0
author: Ava
description: Prototype of new chat UI preview in legacy settings, enabling Chat 2.0 as a non-AI agent customer, and the ability to temporarily revery back

name: Ads to Convo
author: Ava
description: Brand-switchable demo of ads-to-conversation flows: Instagram ad → PDP / half-sheet / direct chat with multi-turn AI dialogue, recommendation card, and a per-brand live edit panel.

name: Kollo · Ads to Messaging (user testing)
author: Ava
description: Kollo-only build of the ads-to-messaging prototype for user testing. Locked to the Kollo brand, no top nav (brand selector, reset, edit panel, title all stripped), and the OG flow is hidden — toggle shows only PDP / Halfsheet / Direct to chat.

name: Farmacy · Cart Recovery Chat
author: Ava
description: Mobile prototype of a post-SMS cart-recovery chat on Farmacy's Honey Skincare collection. Tapping the floating chat icon opens a full-page Farmacy skincare-expert chat with Claude-style SPQs stacked above the input. Tapping the product card opens a Honey Halo PDP with subscribe/one-time, SPQs, and Add-to-cart. Live edit panel for chat copy, SPQs, and a regex-keyed response library — all persisted to localStorage.

name: SPQs — Shopping Assistant (3 flows)
author: Ava
description: Suggested Prompted Questions on a Hotel Lobby Candle storefront with a topbar flow switcher: ASAP (floating SPQ pills above the chat launcher), Medium term (centered bottom 'Chat to shop' bar that slides right to open the chat), and Longer term (no floating SPQs — header search opens an AI-suggestions overlay). Shared chat: SPQ → answer → scent quick-replies (warm/fresh/moody) → 3 matching products → PDP bottom drawer + Add to Cart. SPQs appear on Home and all collection pages. Includes the Gorgias admin (Axiom) Shopping Assistant page with the SPQ configuration drawer.
